storage.ownedArrays: 5 small primitive arrays + 2 outer tables + ceil(N/32768) + ceil(K/32768) chunks
storage.identity: all owned arrays fresh, non-null, pairwise distinct within and across live measurements; no borrowed/exposed/static/native/offheap/pool storage
storage.initialBits: all storage raw +0 except coefficients; tree[0] stays raw +0
storage.constructor: allocate directly in chunks; never allocate a flat temporary; outer references never subsequently change
storage.localAccessValidation: positive logical length; index in logical range; exact outer length; visited page non-null with canonical exact length before access
storage.treeValidation: N>0; 2L*N-1<=Integer.MAX_VALUE; outer tables non-null/distinct and exact extents for N/K; node/leaf/range/window bounds before access
storage.canonicalPrecondition: complete shape and identity guaranteed by construction and measured deeply in tests; helpers do not scan unvisited pages or promise rejection of arbitrary unvisited corruption
storage.physicalConservativeBound: 8*(N+K)+40*(ceil(N/32768)+ceil(K/32768))+704 <= 16*N+1024; runtime verifies fixed<=640, array overhead<=32, references<=8

virtualTree.virtualParent: K<=node<N: validated ring[2*node-N] + validated ring[2*node+1-N], validate result; left then right then sum
virtualTree.rebuild: validate leaf, visit every ancestor from (N+leaf)/2 to 1; same children and validation order; write only node<K
virtualTree.work: O(1) local access; O(log N) update/range; O(1) getters; no recursive subtree or per-frame chunk scan
